title: Domestic Pressure Cookers — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for domestic pressure cookers made of aluminum alloy or stainless steel with capacities from 1L to 15L, operating pressures 0.5 to 1.1 bar.
scopeHi: यह मानक 1 लीटर से 15 लीटर क्षमता वाले एल्युमिनियम मिश्र धातु या स्टेनलेस स्टील से बने घरेलू प्रेशर कुकरों के लिए सुरक्षा और गुणवत्ता आवश्यकताओं को निर्दिष्ट करता है।

keyTests.name: Operating Pressure Test
keyTests.description: Verifies cooker maintains nominal operating pressure without steam leakage.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Within ±10% of declared operating pressure (typically 1.0 kg/cm²)

keyTests.name: Proof Pressure Test
keyTests.description: Body and lid subjected to internal hydrostatic pressure.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Must withstand 2.5 times operating pressure without permanent distortion.

keyTests.name: Bursting Pressure Test
keyTests.description: Container withstands extreme pressure before rupture.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Shall not burst at less than 4.5 times normal working pressure.

keyTests.name: Safety Valve Operating Test
keyTests.description: Safety fuse release under excess pressure.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Releases pressure between 1.5 to 2.2 times operating pressure.

keyTests.name: Gasket Release Mechanism
keyTests.description: Controlled release of excess steam downwards away from user.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Operates if vent tube and safety valve are blocked.

markingRequirements: Each pressure cooker must bear the ISI Standard Mark along with License Number (CM/L-XXXXXXXXXX), manufacturer name, capacity in liters, working pressure, and material grade.
consumerTips: Always verify the 7 or 8-digit CM/L license number below the ISI logo using the BIS Care App.
Check that safety valve is metallic fusible alloy certified and gasket is food-grade silicone.
Never buy pressure cookers without the ISI Mark - it is legally mandatory in India.
industryGuidelines: Factory audit required for Scheme-I licensing including raw material chemical testing (IS 21/IS 6911).
Routine batch testing for every 500 units: hydrostatic proof pressure, safety valve release pressure.

clauses.title: Material Specifications
clauses.content: Bodies and lids shall be manufactured from wrought aluminium alloy (IS 21) or austenitic stainless steel AISI 304 (IS 6911). Handles must be heat-resistant phenolic moulding (IS 1300).
clauses.contentHi: ढांचा और ढक्कन IS 21 एल्युमिनियम या IS 6911 स्टेनलेस स्टील 304 से बने होंगे।

clauses.title: Safety Devices & Pressure Relief
clauses.content: Every cooker shall be equipped with at least two independent safety relief mechanisms: a weighted pressure regulator/vent tube and a secondary safety valve.
clauses.contentHi: कुकर में रेगुलेटर वेंट ट्यूब और बैकअप सेफ्टी वाल्व सहित दो स्वतंत्र सुरक्षा उपकरण होने अनिवार्य हैं।

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Proof and Burst Pressure
clauses.content: Body with closed lid shall withstand minimum hydraulic pressure of 250 kPa (2.5 bar) without distortion. Rupture shall not occur below 450 kPa.
clauses.contentHi: कुकर बिना किसी विरूपण के न्यूनतम 250 kPa (2.5 बार) का दबाव सहन करने योग्य होना चाहिए।

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — General Requirements
titleHi: घरेलू और समान विद्युत उपकरणों की सुरक्षा — सामान्य आवश्यकताएं
scope: Deals with safety of electrical appliances for household purposes, rated voltage not more than 250V single-phase (electric irons, immersion heaters, mixer grinders, toasters, geysers).
scopeHi: यह मानक घरेलू उपयोग के विद्युत उपकरणों (इलेक्ट्रिक आयरन, वॉटर हीटर, मिक्सी) की सुरक्षा से संबंधित है।

keyTests.name: High Voltage Electric Strength Test
keyTests.description: Tests insulation barrier breakdown between live parts and enclosure.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Withstand 1250V AC (Class I) or 3750V AC (Class II) for 1 minute

keyTests.name: Leakage Current & Earth Continuity
keyTests.description: Verifies protection against electric shock during normal operation.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Earth resistance < 0.1 Ω; Leakage current < 0.75 mA for Class I portable appliances

keyTests.name: Thermal Heating & Abnormal Operation
keyTests.description: Operated at 1.15 times rated power under locked rotor conditions.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Enclosure temp rise must not exceed safe limit (60K for handles)

markingRequirements: Mandatory marking of Rated Voltage (V), Rated Power (W/kW), Model name, Manufacturer name or Trademark, and ISI Standard Mark with CM/L license number.
consumerTips: Check for 3-pin earthed plugs on high wattage heating appliances (irons, geysers, room heaters).
Ensure electric immersion rods have the ISI mark; uncertified rods cause severe shock hazards.
industryGuidelines: 100% routine testing for High Voltage dielectric breakdown and Earth bond continuity on assembly lines.

clauses.title: Protection Against Electric Shock
clauses.content: Appliances shall be constructed so that adequate protection exists against accidental contact with live parts.
clauses.contentHi: उपकरणों में सक्रिय विद्युत भागों के आकस्मिक संपर्क से पूर्ण सुरक्षा होनी चाहिए।

clauses.title: Leakage Current at Operating Temperature
clauses.content: Leakage current shall not exceed 0.75 mA for portable Class I appliances and 0.25 mA for Class II appliances.
clauses.contentHi: क्लास I पोर्टेबल उपकरणों के लिए लीकेज करंट 0.75 mA से अधिक नहीं होना चाहिए।

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Rated Voltage up to 250 V and Current up to 16 A — Specification
titleHi: 250 V तक के वोल्टेज और 16 A तक के करंट के लिए प्लग और सॉकेट — विशिष्‍टि
scope: Covers plugs and fixed or portable socket-outlets for AC only, rated from 2.5 A up to 16 A / 250 V for household and commercial electrical installations.
scopeHi: यह घरों और कार्यालयों में प्रयुक्त होने वाले 6A और 16A 3-पिन प्लग और सॉकेट के आयाम, इन्सुलेशन और सुरक्षा शटर मानकों को नियंत्रित करता है।

keyTests.name: Safety Shutter Engagement Test
keyTests.description: Ensures foreign objects cannot enter live contacts.
keyTests.parameterLimit: 1 mm probe must not touch live parts under 20 N force

keyTests.name: Temperature Rise Test
keyTests.description: Tested at 1.25 times rated current for 1 hour.

markingRequirements: Indelibly stamped: IS 1293, ISI logo, CM/L number, Rated Voltage (250V), Rated Current (6A or 16A), Terminal markings (L, N, E).
consumerTips: Never use ungrounded 2-pin plugs on metal-cased appliances; use ISI 3-pin plugs.
industryGuidelines: Brass terminals must pass mercurous nitrate stress corrosion test.

clauses.title: Live Part Contact Protection
clauses.content: Sockets shall prevent access to live parts when a plug is withdrawn.
clauses.contentHi: प्लग निकालने पर सॉकेट के शटर स्वतः बंद होने चाहिए।

title: Safety of Lamp Controlgear — Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules (LED Drivers)
titleHi: लैंप कंट्रोलगियर की सुरक्षा — एलईडी ड्राइवर
qcoOrder: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Compulsory Registration) Order (MeitY)
scope: Covers safety requirements for electronic controlgear for DC supplies up to 250 V or AC supplies up to 1000 V for constant voltage or constant current LED modules.
scopeHi: यह एलईडी बल्ब और स्ट्रीट लाइट्स के लिए एलईडी ड्राइवरों के बीआईएस पंजीकरण को अनिवार्य करता है।
markingRequirements: BIS CRS Standard Mark with R-XXXXXXXX registration number.
consumerTips: Check for R-XXXXXXXX registration mark on LED power supplies to prevent surge fire hazards.
industryGuidelines: Evaluated at BIS recognized test laboratory under MeitY scheme.

clauses.title: Fault Conditions
clauses.content: Controlgear shall remain safe during short circuit or open circuit conditions.
clauses.contentHi: कंट्रोलगियर शॉर्ट-सर्किट या लोड कटने पर सुरक्षित रहना चाहिए।
